tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Return one invoice by its number, including line items, tax breakdown and the current payment state. Use this when the caller already knows exactly which invoice they mean.

invoiceNumber.description: The human-facing invoice number, for example INV-2024-0091.

tools.name: list_overdue_invoices
tools.description: Enumerate invoices whose due date has passed and which are not yet settled, oldest first. Answers questions about who owes money, not about one specific document.

minimumDaysLate.description: Skip anything less overdue than this.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Move money back to the payer's original method. The transfer is irreversible once the payment processor accepts it, and a partial amount is allowed.

amountCents.description: Omit to refund the whole payment.

tools.name: schedule_dunning_reminder
tools.description: Queue a polite payment chase to be delivered on a future date. Calling it twice for the same debtor replaces the pending message rather than adding a second one.
